archived_at.title: Archived At
archived_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was archived, or `null` if the Workspace is not archived.

compartment_id.title: Compartment Id
compartment_id.description:
Identifier for this Workspace's encryption compartment. When you configure a
customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) on AWS, reference this value in your
KMS key-policy condition so the key is scoped to this compartment. On GCP and
Azure, Anthropic enforces the compartment binding automatically; you do not
need to reference this value in your key configuration. See the CMEK integration guide for the
required key configuration, including the value used during key validation.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was created.

display_color.title: Display Color
display_color.description: Hex color code representing the Workspace in the Anthropic Console.

external_key_id.title: External Key Id
external_key_id.description:
ID of the customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) configuration to use for this
Workspace. Setting this field requires CMEK to be enabled for your
organization. When set, data stored for this Workspace is encrypted with the
referenced key. Create key configurations with the External Keys API. This
field is write-once: once a key is attached to a Workspace it cannot be
detached or replaced. To rotate key material, rotate the underlying key on
your cloud KMS; the `external_key_id` stays the same.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: User-defined tags as string key-value pairs. Keys may not begin with `anthropic`.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Object type.

For Workspaces, this is always `"workspace"`.

allowed_inference_geos.title: Allowed Inference Geos
allowed_inference_geos.description: Permitted inference geo values. 'unrestricted' means all geos are allowed.

default_inference_geo.title: Default Inference Geo
default_inference_geo.description: Default inference geo applied when requests omit the parameter.

workspace_geo.title: Workspace Geo
workspace_geo.description: Geographic region for workspace data storage. Immutable after creation.
